case_level_notes: Upstream CRA transmission duty fails (missing source documents); recipient-side furnisher duty is satisfied on materials actually received; case is routed to human review.

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: Determination scoped to CRA transmission completeness; does not assert other downstream failures.
determinations.decisive_branch: CRA-to-furnisher notice path: primary documents not forwarded

material_facts.fact: CRA notice contained account number and dispute code but not the settlement letter or bank-statement images
Source documents were missing from the transmission

determinations.rationale: The CRA's notice to the bank omitted the referenced settlement letter and bank-statement images, so the CRA did not include all relevant information from the consumer as required.

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: Item-treatment determination concerns verified/current status of the item under the selected branch and does not import the CRA transmission failure.
determinations.decisive_branch: Item verified as accurate and recorded current (no defect found by furnisher on materials received)

material_facts.fact: Bank reviewed the materials it received and recorded the item as verified from the bank ledger
No reseller, reinsertion, or veteran-medical branch in play

determinations.rationale: The bank, on the materials it received, reviewed and verified the item against its ledger; under the bank-perspective item-treatment override the verified/current status branch is satisfied. Downstream CRA transmission failure is treated under a separate determination.

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: Per instructions, a failed upstream CRA transmission can coexist with a satisfied recipient-side furnisher duty where the recipient reviewed what it received.
determinations.decisive_branch: Furnisher indirect duties: investigation conducted, reviewed CRA-transmitted info, results reported

material_facts.fact: Bank reviewed materials received and responded to the CRA
Bank recorded the item as verified from its ledger

determinations.rationale: The bank received the CRA notice, investigated using the materials it actually received, and reported results back to the CRA. The recipient-side furnisher duty is satisfied even though the CRA's upstream transmission was incomplete.

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: Not-applicable branch returns true per policy guidance on inapplicable duty branches.
determinations.decisive_branch: Branch not applicable: no direct furnisher dispute mentioned

material_facts.fact: Dispute came via the CRA, not directly to the bank

determinations.rationale: No direct furnisher dispute was sent to the bank; the direct-dispute branch is not applicable and treated as satisfied.

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: Routing is separate from substantive duties; manual-review routing does not by itself fail item-treatment or furnisher-indirect determinations.
determinations.decisive_branch: Routing trigger: missing primary source documents and manual-review policy invoked

material_facts.fact: Bank opened manual review because source documents were missing from transmission

determinations.rationale: Source documents were missing from the CRA transmission and the bank explicitly opened manual review, triggering the human-review routing condition.
